- **Not checked against the contract:** the signed amendment isn't in any file I can read. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to confirm before the QBR deck goes out.
- **No approval needed:** a seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, and Dana is on the account's team. I didn't share any prices or contract terms.
